description: Defines traffic filtering for an app component. When any field is set, a default deny is in effect unless overridden by defaultDNSPolicy.

allowedHostSets.description: The list of host sets whose domains are allowed.
allowedHostSets.title: allowedHostSets

blockedHostSets.description: The list of host sets whose domains are explicitly blocked.
blockedHostSets.title: blockedHostSets

blockedIPSets.description: The list of IP set names whose CIDR blocks are explicitly blocked.
blockedIPSets.title: blockedIPSets

defaultDNSPolicy.description: The default policy applied to DNS traffic not matched by any Host set.
defaultDNSPolicy.title: defaultDNSPolicy
